english.note: University minimums; official scores required unless qualifying-country/US bachelor exemption.

applicationFee.note: $65 US;$90 international. Need-based waiver only US citizens/PR pursuing first graduate degree.

requirements.note: At least one recommender must be research mentor. Both central application and INP supplements required. No specific courses; basic science/math encouraged. Research experience particularly important.

funding.note: Undated published $40,000 stipend guaranteed5years for all admitted INP students, subject to good standing, satisfactory academic/professional performance and funds. At least one semester TA. International applicants eligible for some competitive fellowships.
